create_criteo_dataset: create a CriteoDataset instance to load and preprocess Kaggle or Terabyte Criteo advertising data for DLRM training
create_random_dataset: create a RandomDataset instance to generate synthetic random or trace-driven input batches for DLRM model training
generate_uniform_input_batch: generate a uniform random batch of dense and sparse feature tensors for DLRM embedding lookups
generate_synthetic_input_batch: generate a synthetic input batch using LRU trace-driven stack distance distributions for realistic sparse feature access patterns
run_synthetic_distribution_generator: run the CLI to profile a trace file, compute stack distance distributions, and generate a synthetic LRU trace
